description: This file defines an interface IClusterMembershipService in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, outlining methods and properties for querying and managing cluster membership status within the Orleans distributed system framework.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Property to get the most recent cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Property to get an asynchronous stream of membership updates.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Method to refresh the cluster membership data if it does not meet the minimum version.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Method to declare a silowed (silo address) defunct and possibly evict it.
